place.name: Norway House
place.description: Norway House is a population centre of over 5,000 people, some 30 km (19 mi) north of Lake Winnipeg, on the eastern channel of the Nelson River, in the province of Manitoba, Canada. Norway House has three meanings: the unincorporated community; the First Nation reserve of the Norway House Cree Nation (Kinosao Sipi Cree Nation); and both together.
